title: Draw Shapes
text: 在图像上绘制矩形、线、多边形或圆，输入 7 路、输出 1 路；按 {Shape} 指定要绘制的形状；{Fill shapes} 指定用颜色填充形状、{Line width} 指定形状的线宽、{Fill color source} 用于指定填充色的输入源 Specify via、{Fill color} 用于填充形状的颜色、{Border color source} 用于指定边框颜色的输入源 Specify via、{Border color} 指定形状的轮廓颜色、{Color value(s)} 用于绘制边框或填充形状的颜色值 scalar、{Opacity factor (between 0 and 1)} 指定颜色的不透明度 value in the range、{Use antialiasing} 指定平滑算法、{Draw shapes in} 绘制形状的区域 Entire、{Image signal} 指定图像信号的输入端口数 One multidimensional，按实例取值。

ports.name: Image
ports.summary: 输入图像或视频流 M -by- N matrix of intensity values | M -by- N -by- 3 array of color values

ports.name: R
ports.summary: 图像或视频帧的红色通道 M -by- N matrix

ports.name: G
ports.summary: 图像或视频帧的绿色通道 M -by- N matrix

ports.name: B
ports.summary: 图像或视频帧的蓝色通道 M -by- N matrix

ports.name: Pts
ports.summary: 形状坐标 M -by-3 matrix | M -by-4 matrix | M -by-2 L matrix

ports.name: Clr
ports.summary: 形状颜色 3-element vector | M -by- 3 matrix

ports.name: Port_1
ports.summary: 输出图像 M -by- N matrix of intensity values | M -by- N -by- 3 array of color values

params.name: Shape
params.values: 要绘制的形状 Rectangles (default) | Lines | Polygons | Circles

params.name: Fill shapes
params.values: 用颜色填充形状 off (default) | on

params.name: Fill color source
params.values: 用于指定填充色的输入源 Specify via dialog (default) | Input port

params.name: Fill color
params.values: 用于填充形状的颜色 Black (default) | White | User-specified value

params.name: Border color source
params.values: 用于指定边框颜色的输入源 Specify via dialog (default) | Input port

params.name: Border color
params.values: 形状的轮廓颜色 Black (default) | White | User-specified value

params.name: Color value(s)
params.values: 用于绘制边框或填充形状的颜色值 scalar | 3-element vector

params.name: Opacity factor (between 0 and 1)
params.values: 颜色的不透明度 value in the range [0,1] | R -element vector

params.name: Draw shapes in
params.values: 绘制形状的区域 Entire image (default) | Specify region of interest via port

params.name: Image signal
params.values: 图像信号的输入端口数 One multidimensional signal (default) | Separate color signals
